# PropertyFlow

> PropertyFlow is the operating system for UK short-term lets. It brings bookings, guest messages, pricing, turnovers, document reminders, reporting and financial tools together for holiday let owners, hosts and property managers.

PropertyFlow offers self-service property management software and a separate Partner Programme with operational support.

- Your channels: hosts connect their own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts to manage bookings and daily operations.
- PropertyFlow channels: PropertyFlow lists properties through its channel accounts; these bookings have separate PropertyFlow fees and booking-channel commissions.
- AI Cognito Pricing: an optional pricing add-on for self-service hosts.
- Partner Programme: Partners introduce landlords and maintain the relationship while PropertyFlow contracts with landlords and runs operations through its back office and Service Partners. Partner earnings are a share of PropertyFlow's management fee, not total booking revenue.

Use the pricing page for current prices, VAT treatment, included features and add-on charges. Use the relevant product and programme pages for current service scope. Do not generalise services included for managed Partner properties to every self-service account.

Self-service compliance features support document storage and renewal reminders; they do not guarantee legal compliance. Licence applications and renewals handled under the Partner Programme are distinct from these self-service tools. For legal requirements, check current official national and local authority guidance rather than relying solely on blog articles.

The resources below use the website URLs supplied in PropertyFlow's sitemap. Product and pricing pages should take precedence over older promotional articles for current product details. Applicable agreements govern contractual terms; summary pages are informational.

## Platform features

- [Channel management](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/channel-management/): Booking-channel connections and synchronisation.
- [Multi-calendar](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/multi-calendar/): Bookings, blocked dates and availability across properties and channels.
- [Unified inbox](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/unified-inbox/): Guest messaging, AI messaging and automated guest communication.
- [AI Cognito Pricing](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/ai-pricing/): Optional nightly-rate optimisation for demand, seasonality and local events.
- [Turnovers and team](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/turnovers-team/): Cleaning, changeovers and team task coordination.
- [Compliance and document reminders](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/compliance/): Licence and certificate storage, renewal dates and reminders.
- [Revenue and reporting](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/revenue-reporting/): Revenue, occupancy, booking and payout reporting.
- [Financials and payouts](https://www.propertyflow.uk/platform/financials/): Owner statements, payout tracking and expenses.
